title: Three Women on Porch with Flowers, 1920s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage 1920 snapshot depicting three young women posing together on a residential porch decorated with blooming flowers and potted plants. One woman sits in the foreground while two others sit together on a chair in a friendly embrace. The date '1920' is handwritten in ink on the front lower right corner. This photo captures casual domestic life and informal fashion in the early roaring twenties.
